ops.sql: SELECT TOP 20 d.DocID, d.Version, d.DocDate, DATALENGTH(d.BinContent) / 1048576.0 AS mb FROM t_document d WHERE d.DocType = 'Baseline' ORDER BY d.DocDate DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CAST(DATALENGTH(BinContent) AS bigint)) / 1048576.0 AS mb_total, MAX(DATALENGTH(BinContent)) / 1048576.0 AS mb_max FROM t_document WHERE DocType = 'Baseline'
